facts.fact: The Fundo de Estradas, a Mozambican public fund, runs the Portal de Divulgacao de Dados de Infra-estruturas Publicas (IPDP), which publishes data on road, bridge and other public infrastructure projects and was validated as an OC4IDS publisher in 2026; the page has no date, so the capture date 2026-08-08 is used.

facts.fact: The IPDP portal of the Fundo de Estradas states its data is available under a Creative Commons licence with attribution; the page has no date, so the capture date 2026-08-08 is used.
